contents_summary: Three-page PDF: Appendix S1 CMR protocol (pages 1 and 2, methods only) and Table S1 (page 3) with right heart catheterization values for case 1 and case 2 before and after PTE: 12 hemodynamic rows by 4 columns (48 cells, 2 printed dashes) with printed dates and day counts relative to PTE.

pages.contents: Appendix S1 CMR protocol, page 1 of 3: MRI hardware (1.5T scanner, coil arrays), sequence parameters for standard cine and for the radial perfusion sequence, gadobutrol and adenosine administration parameters, and the start of the cardiac functional parameters paragraph. Page header notes that supplemental materials are not copyedited.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Imaging protocol description (scanner hardware, sequence parameters, contrast and stress agent doses). It does not tie any value to an individual patient or time point, so no patient-level clinical facts are extracted.
limitations: No printed rights notice other than the RSNA copyright line; the article source license is retained without blanket relicensing.

pages.contents: Appendix S1 page 2 of 3: continuation of cardiac functional parameter segmentation (EDV, ESV, SV, EF) and the myocardial perfusion reserve quantification method (arterial input function, tissue function reconstruction, MBF and MPR calculation). Lower half of the page is blank.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Methods text only; no patient-specific values.
limitations: No printed rights notice other than the repeated peer-review disclaimer header.

pages.contents: Table S1 with caption: right heart catheterization performed before and after PTE for both cases. A bordered table has column groups Case 1 and Case 2, each with two date columns and a day-count label (pre-PTE or post-PTE), and a units column. Rows: RAP, PASP, PADP, mPAP, SVO2, PCWP, CO - Fick, CI - Fick, PVR, HR, SV and PA Compliance. Two cells (Case 2 post-PTE PCWP and PVR) print a dash. The caption states PVR was calculated as (mPAP - PCWP)/CO-Fick and spells out the abbreviations.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Patient-level right heart catheterization values for case 1 and case 2 before and after PTE. Case labels match the article case labels; the article text cites Table S1 in the case 1 and case 2 paragraphs.
limitations: The table prints calendar dates for each catheterization; they are kept only as context transcriptions and not parsed to ISO dates.
Document inspection is an AI source review, not physician adjudication or a measure of clinical accuracy.
Pages 1 and 2 are protocol methods and were read in full but yield no patient-level facts.

transcriptions.text: RHC performed pre and post PTE for both cases.
to keep consistency, the PVR was calculated as PVR = (mPAP - PCWP)/CO-Fick.

limitations: All 48 value cells of Table S1 are typed with exact page, table, row and column provenance; two printed dashes are recorded as not reported.
Printed calendar dates are context only; times use the printed day-count labels relative to PTE.
Case labels 1 and 2 are linked to p1 and p2 by the matching case labels and the article citations of Table S1 in the case paragraphs, not by numerical similarity of values.

The text approximates the case 1 follow-up RHC as about 3 months after PTE and the case 2 one as 4 months after PTE; the table gives 78 and 117 days. These are recorded as separate statements and are not merged.
